source_scope: Frozen canonical full-model source columns; replace only the historical-match column. Agreement is an ordinary explicit column when selected. Other raw columns are identical across banks.
supervision: Validation complete-bundle groups split into 70% fitting / 30% tuning. All supervised fits and amplified-neighbor choice use fitting groups only. Final hyperparameter choices use full-catalogue tuning NDCG. No refit after tuning.
artifact_policy: Read previous artifacts/caches only; keep new arrays, recipes, models and query results. Source/protocol/input mismatches reject resume; never silently overwrite completed work.
interpretation: Exploratory supplied-split follow-up. Canonical original scorer is a separately labelled reference selected on all validation queries. Raw-factor tests condition on a previously selected source inventory. Not a complete HOSLIM reproduction or an untouched-split confirmation.
